name: robots/code-iai__iai_kinect2
title: Kinect v2 depth camera (iai_kinect2)
intro: Kinect v2 depth camera (iai_kinect2), adapted from code-iai/iai_kinect2. It reads `frame_id`, `width` and `height`; runs `capture_image`. `capture_image`: capture a single image from a named camera with a declared resolution and exposure and return an image artifact reference. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
